listing.title: Setter Tombstone Plaque, Geometric Art on Ceramic, Customizable with Your Photo
listing.description:
A ceramic tombstone plaque for your Setter, with a geometric portrait of the breed. Use it as a grave marker or as a keepsake in a place of remembrance, made to last outdoors. Prefer your own dog's portrait? Attach a photo and we will print it in the original or with the background removed.

IN SHORT
- Ceramic oval plaque, approx. 10.5 x 7.5 cm (4.13 x 2.95 in), approx. 0.5 cm (0.2 in) thick
- Modern geometric portrait of a Setter, or your own photo
- Weather-resistant print that does not fade
- Smooth, rounded edge, no extra frame or setting needed
- No hole or hook on the back, attach it with any universal adhesive
- Personalisation available: your photo, print style, name and dates

A TRIBUTE THAT STAYS WITH YOU
A ceramic plaque is a gentle way to remember a dog who has passed away. The smooth edge needs no special frame, the high-quality print is made to last, and personalisation lets you make the plaque truly yours.

PERSONALISATION
Order the plaque exactly as shown, or personalise it. Every option below is optional.
- Your photo: we can print any photo you send us. Attach it in the personalisation box when ordering, or send it by Etsy message.
- Style: for your own photo, choose the original or full colour with the background removed.
- Name and dates: add your dog's name, or name and dates of life, to the geometric portrait or to your own photo, or leave the plaque without text.
- Orientation: a plaque with your photo can be placed vertically or horizontally.

Questions about personalising your plaque? Send us a message, we will gladly help.

We would be honoured to help you say goodbye to your beloved dog with dignity.

INTERNATIONAL ORDERS
Our products are shipped from Poland, so import charges may apply in some countries. These charges do not apply to EU countries, the United Kingdom and the USA. If you have any doubts, please contact us for details.

personalization_questions.question_text: Do you want to personalize the plaque?

personalization_questions.instructions: Attach a clear photo of your pet, or send it later by Etsy message. Leave empty if you chose No.
Name, or name and dates, as they should appear, e.g. Felix 12/29/2013 - 11/9/2026. Leave empty for no text.
